name: Night look and photo mode
body: Dean (2026-11-16): with everything fully lit the companion's light and the lantern do nothing you can see, so the levels move to night and the lights show how the mechanics work. And a second kind of collectible: photographs of sights, taken together with the companion, for more variety in what the character does. Both are optional and block nothing.
acceptance_criteria: Every chapter reads as night, with the companion, lantern, posts, goal and gems as the visible light
Photo mode: raise the camera, frame a sight, take the photo, see it counted on the HUD and on the level complete screen
Each new piece has a decision in docs/decisions.md and a doc section
Frame time stays well above 60 fps
Screenshots are in the project thread
